dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped patterns across the mid-lateral flank. Prominent annuli exhibit sharp, low-intensity (dark) perimeters with an abrupt gradient transition to higher-intensity (light grey/white) interior cores. Edges are irregular but generally continuous, particularly in the central flank region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of solid low-intensity pixel clusters (dark spots) located primarily in the interstitial spaces between the larger annuli. These features lack an internal gradient and appear as compact, asymmetrical solid-color nodes.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent macro-annuli on the mid-flank form an irregular quadrilateral. The spatial relationship between the two largest anterior annuli and the primary posterior annulus defines an obtuse triangular geometry with the longest axis oriented longitudinally.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a large, high-intensity (bright) diffuse patch on the anterior dorsal-lateral region containing nested, lower-contrast circular micro-patterns.
